name: cable hip abduction v. 2
description: Standing hip abduction against a low cable that trains the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine and hold a support.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg slightly bent.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
